5ca6748a37b88b269472dad9: Nonnie must figure out how to lead the marching band when a duck gets in its way.
The Bubble Guppies learn about trees.
The children try to figure out how to get Mr. Grouper's car started after it breaks down on the way to an amusement park.

Ninjas Zooli and Oona are excited about their first mission: escorting snow monkey Moshi up Mt. Danger to join his troop; but it won't be easy: a storm looms, and mischievous Moshi is causing trouble.
The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.
After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.
When rain spoils a game of kickball, Gil invents a new game; Bubble Puppy must overcome his fear of thunder to save the game.

It's Team Flightless versus cocky Amelia the peregrine falcon; though Penguin Nonny, Ostrich Oona, and Kiwi Goby can't fly, these birds of a feather flock together; teamwork must be enough for them to win the race.
Molly wants to be a cowgirl like Dusty.
The Guppies must move fast when a herd of cows wanders onto the train tracks.
The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer.

Capt. Deema and first mate Gil pilot their steampunk sub to different ocean habitats so they can deliver Friendship Day bubblegrams to all their friends; along the way, they find themselves being chased by a kraken.
The Bubble Guppies learn about farm animals.
When an actor cannot perform at a play, Deema must take the stage.
Oona's friend must visit a doctor when he breaks a bone in his tail.
Molly, Gil and the Guppies must lead a baby dolphin named Buddy to the surprise birthday party his pod is throwing for him.
A nature show host teaches the Guppies about Australian animals.
Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.
The Bubble Guppies learn about dinosaurs.
The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.
The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space.
Molly performs in the quick-change dress-up match during Fashion Week in Bubbletucky and ends up on the cover of a fashion magazine.
Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.
On the hottest day of the year, Rangers Goby and Gil's job is to make sure pedestrians reach the lake safely; however, Bigfoot causes issues when he removes the stop signs from the park.

In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.
Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.
Mail carrier Molly tries to deliver a Friendship Day card for someone named Alison in a place called Wonderland; the card-stealing Queen of Hearts bans Friendship Day across the land.
The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time.
The Mayor gets a tummy ache while training for Bubbletucky's annual marathon and has to go to the hospital to get checked out.
Chicken Farmers Deema and Goby discover an unusual egg on their farm one morning, and set off on a bayou river adventure to find the egg's mama.
Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.
Goby and Gil go on a quest to get a geode at the top of a volcano, then try to make it back to the Rocky Valley Rock Show in time to enter the contest for best rock.
A veterinarian takes care of Bubble Puppy when he has a cold.
When supervillain Felina Meow starts turning all the dogs at the annual dog show into cats, it's up to superheroes Puppy Girl and Super Pup to stop her.
The Monster Machines are eager to see Darington's stunt track, but Crusher tricks Darington, sending him far away.
When Space Commander Megan is marooned on Pluto, the robot heroes race through wormholes, shoot past ice volcanoes, and blast straight through an asteroid field to bring their new friend back home.
When Blaze and Starla discover a map that leads to the legendary Bouncing Bull Racetrack, the friends set out on a Wild West quest to find the track and take the ride of their lives.
Gasquatch has been saving his money to buy a toy, but when his money goes missing Blaze must help him find it before the toy store closes.

Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.
6401d85a49839300087b116c: A former DEA agent (Jason Statham) returns to action to save his daughter and his new town from a drug-dealing sociopath (James Franco).
A mutual, obsessive desire for revenge draws together two strangers (Colin Farrell, Noomi Rapace) along on an escalating trail of mayhem.
A vacation in Spain turns nightmarish when a man's (Henry Cavill) family is kidnapped by agents who are hell-bent on recovering a mysterious briefcase.
After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.
John Gotti rises to the top of the New York underworld to become the boss of the Gambino crime family. His life takes a tumultuous turn as he faces tragedy, multiple trials and a prison sentence.
Following violent, targeted attacks on 15 Division, the officers must piece together a past crime in order to find Oliver; the shooter's plan is revealed.

While off-duty, Andy and Dov become involved in a holdup at a diner; Nick goes rogue to search for Sam Swarek's next of kin; Andy is faced with both the men she cares for and must reveal her decision.
Oliver is promoted to Acting Staff Sergeant; a new rookie joins the force.
Before Fight Night, the officers have to seize all proceeds from crime.
Andy worries Duncan may not be suited to the job; when the body of an executed gang leader is found, 15 Division works to prevent a gang war from breaking out; Gail makes a harrowing discovery.
An astronomy professor discovers an asteroid is on a collision course with Earth, and rushes to get his family to safety while alerting the world to the danger.
Smoke jumpers and tanker pilots try to save stranded teens and an entire Oregon town from three raging fires.

Quando a rena da peça some, Sam e Austin tentam salvar o Natal e seu relacionamento.
Adivinhe Quem Vem para o Natal

Dax é um astro do rock que quer recuperar sua imagem manchada e se compromete a cumprir o desejo de Natal de uma criança. Agora, ele será obrigado a passar uns dias com uma família em uma cidade pequena, onde o destino vai surpreendê-lo.
Para agradar sua família durante o Natal, Marci, uma mulher solteira e focada em sua carreira profissional, finge estar noiva de seu assistente, Adam.
Uma jovem lidando com a dor e uma mulher solitária se conectam de forma inesperada. Com a magia do Natal, elas descobrem que amor, perdão e segundas chances são os maiores presentes.
Um Conto de Fadas nas Montanhas: Entrando para a Realeza
É Natal novamente e a Dra. Tasha está a caminho para encontrar o Príncipe Alexander em St. Savarre.

Lucas, um rico empresário francês, vai a Montana para uma proposta de negócio muito atraente. Lá, ele conhece Robin, se apaixona e a leva para Paris em uma incrível aventura de Natal. Mas será que os negócios acabarão com esse romance?
A designer de interiores Priscilla Hall e sua assistente Wendy disputam as atenções do namorado socialite de Priscilla enquanto decoram sua casa para as férias.

Durante a temporada de Natal, três irmãs terão que decidir o que fazer com sua vida romântica quando partem para encontrar a família para as festas e seus respectivos pares surgem na cidade para tentar uma segunda chance.
Katie entra em competição de lenhadores para salvar o negócio da família e encontra o amor.
